text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 9: The ensemble mean beats the control member, and beats feeding each member through the model, at almost every horizon'
text.tspan: Figure 9: The ensemble mean beats the control member, and beats feeding
each member through the model, at almost every horizon

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Difference in mean absolute error between two ways of using ENS at the same horizon, on the same generator-hours. Planned: both contrasts at day 1; every other mark is exploratory. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, every daylight hour, April 2024 to September 2026. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, every hour, August 2024 to September 2026.'
